method: Manual unblinded source, changed-test, final-source-check, environment and delivery audit of unchanged archived endpoints. Uniform focused upstream runtime/type witnesses cover three original controls and all18 endpoints; metadata witnesses cover original plus all18. No endpoint repair. Selected official checks, production compatibility, delivered-test validity and full-request acceptance remain separate.

decisions.name: 1-valibot-message-prefix-reference
decisions.note: Three implementation changes add the optional field, conditionally preserve absent-option object shape and apply the prefix after callback resolution. Four required checks rerun after final edit62; earlier compiler failure is retained. No existing tests, configuration or dependencies changed; pinned dependency manifest is unchanged with no additions. Delivery accurately states selected upstream coverage. Separate uniform focused runtime/type witness completed below.
decisions.uniformWitness: All selected original runtime/type assertions and explicit prior generic arity pass on the unchanged endpoint; all three website metadata modules compile against original PropertyProps. Exact added/changed tests pass runtime and type checks.

Original upstream config already enables exactOptionalPropertyTypes; this is an added-test defect, not a production regression or pre-existing baseline failure.
